items.title_en: Narayana Murthy and daughter Akshata enjoy 'Corner House' ice cream in Bengaluru
items.title_zh: Narayana Murthy 和女儿 Akshata 在班加罗尔享用“Corner House”冰淇淋
items.summary_en: A viral picture of Infosys founder Narayana Murthy and his daughter, Akshata Murty, enjoying ice cream together at a popular parlour in Bengaluru has gained attention on social media. The image showcases the simplicity and down-to-earth nature of the Murthy family.
items.summary_zh: Infosys 创始人 Narayana Murthy 和他的女儿 Akshata Murty 在班加罗尔一家受欢迎的店里一起享用冰淇淋的照片在社交媒体上引起了关注。该图像展示了 Murthy 家族的简单和脚踏实地的本质。
